products.body_html:
Pigeon Breastmilk Storage Bottles offer a convenient solution for moms to store and feed, supporting them throughout their breastfeeding journey.

The storage bottle can be placed directly in the fridge or freezer, eliminating the need to transfer breast milk.

Compatible with Pigeon Breast Pumps and SofTouch™ Nipple

Key Features

Ideal solution to store and feed

  • For convenient storage of breast milk in refrigerator or freezer

  • Compatible with Pigeon Breast Pumps

  • BPA/BPS Free

How to use

Breastmilk Storage Recommendation:
Breastmilk is rich in nutrients, so it is highly recommended to store expressed milk in the refrigerator or freezer if not consumed immediately.

Thawing Frozen Breastmilk:
After storing in refrigerator/freezer, thaw milk in warm water (about 40°C).

DO NOT thaw milk using boiling water or microwave oven. Changing water frequently will allow the milk to warm up faster than leaving it in the same water.

*If thawed by immersing in warm water, do not place back in the refrigerator.

Warming Breastmilk:
Warm expressed breastmilk using Pigeon Smart Bottle Warmer or by placing bottle of milk in a container of warm water.

Recommended not to sit fresh, thawed and warmed breast milk at room temperature for more than 2 hours, 10 hours and 1 hour respectively.

Do not mix newly-expressed breast milk with the frozen milk that has been stored.

Precaution:

  • To avoid freezer burn, be sure to compress all the air out of the bag before sealing.Be careful when handling bags.

  • If a frozen bag is scratched, this can weaken the plastic and cause it to leak upon thawing.

  • 9 Adjustable Suction Levels for personalise comfort
  • 2 minutes Auto Switch Mode : Auto switch from Stimulation to Expression mode at 2 minutes
  • Memory Mode: Remembers last pumping session setting on subsequent use

How to use

On first use, the default setting is Stimulation Mode at level 4. During operation, you can press the Expression Button to switch between three modes 9 level for Stimulation, Expression, Rhythmic Expression.

On Subsequent uses, the device automatically switches to the mode and level used during the previous session (Memory Mode); i.e Expression Mode at level 5

The Expression Mode has a rhythm that mimics baby’s sucking motion ensuring a comfortable pumping experience. You can even adjust the suction pressure (level 1 - 9) to suit your needs.

Choose between Stimulation Mode, Expression Mode or Rhythmic Expression Mode according to your needs by pressing the Expression button.

How to clean the product:
Disassemble all parts before washing and sterilizing. Be sure to sterilize before every use.

You can wash the parts with a cleanser such as the Pigeon Liquid Cleanser & Sponge Brush. As the breast pump contains smaller parts please be careful not to lose the small parts during washing.

For washing of the milk valve and flange, we recommend soaking them in lukewarm water and washing using a cleanser. Use fingers to rub gently as strong pressure might cause damage. Do NOT use a brush when washing milk valves.  

Parts made of silicone rubber may be damaged or scratched if they are handled roughly. Therefore, we recommend handling these parts with care. 

If the motor pump unit becomes dirty, please wipe with a dry clean cloth.

Sterilization Method: Boiling, Steam, Chemical or UV*

*It is recommended to replace the product when it starts to discolour and/or turn cloudy

products.title: Startouch Straw Cup Mint To Be 250Ml
products.body_html:
For 6 months and above

Healthy Oral Motor Development with Every Sip

The perfect companion to support your little one's exciting journey to straw drinking.

Co-developed with a Speech and Feeding Therapist, our unique straw helps your baby learn essential oral motor skills like lip closure, proper tongue movement, and ‘suck-swallow-breathe’ coordination—all in a natural and enjoyable way!

This cup is spill- and leak-proof, and made with baby-safe materials, it is BPA and BPS-free. Suitable for 6M+.

Key Features

  • Sensory Bumps: Provides a tactile guide for baby’s lip rounding and closure at the straw tip.
  • Short Straw: The short straw design reaches only to the baby’s tongue tip, supporting tongue tip
    elevation and development of a mature swallow pattern.
  • EasyDrink Valve: Allows for easy, spill-free sipping without hard suction or biting.
  • Gravity Ball Straw: Drink from any angle even as your little one tilts or inverts the cup
  • Compatible with SofTouch™ Nursing Bottles: Turn your existing SofTouch™ Bottles (240ml) into a straw bottle by using the StarTouch™ Adapter and Straw Set.
  • Creating a Baby-Friendly World: More sustainably made with 20% ISCC-Certified Bio-Based Plastic* thus reducing reliance on non-renewable virgin plastics.

*For the Handle, Lid & Connector only, mass balance approach.

How to use

Before first use, disassemble the product and clean thoroughly. Then, place all components in boiling water for 5 minutes. This is to ensure hygiene. Always wash your hands with soap before cleaning, sterilizing and feeding.

For safety and hygiene reasons, The straw top may be worn by biting. Special attention is needed for teething child. Replace the Straw Set when you observe signs of wear tear to maintain optimal condition of the Straw.

After each use: Wash thoroughly with sponge brush to wash cups and adaptor. You may use Pigeon Cleansing Foam Spray to wash the straw and cup, and SofTouch™ Straw Brush for Gravity Ball Straw to wash the Gravity Ball Straw.

Ensure that all parts including areas which may not be visible are thoroughly washed and rinsed to remove any liquid residues. 

What's in the Package

Pigeon StarTouch Straw Cup 250ml 6M+ : 

  • Adaptor & Lid
  • Cup
  • Straw
  • Straw Connector
  • Gravity Ball Straw

    Warranty & Care

  • How to clean:
    Be sure to sterilize before every use.
    Boiling Sterilization: Place all parts in boiling water for 5 minutes.
    Steam Sterilization: You can use Pigeon Steam Sterilizer and follow the directions in the user manual.

    UV' Sterilization is possible. Chemical Sterilization is possible for al parts except the Gravity Sall Straw.
    Use sterilization products made specifically for baby bottles and nipples. Follow the instructions in the user's manual for these products. With chemical sterilization, the printing on the bottle may fade.

    Caution:
    It is recommended to replace the product when it starts to discolour and/ or turn cloudy.

    • Do NOT sterilize or heat the Gravity Ball Straw in a microwave oven.
    • After boiling sterilization, the bottle will be hot. Be careful not to burn yourself.
    • All grease or oil residue should be thoroughly removed before sterilising to avoid permanent staining of parts.

    • Avoid putting hot or carbonated liquids in the cup. The air pressure inside the cup will Increase and leakages might occur from the tip of the straw.
    • Avoid putting hot liquids in the cup as they may cause burns.
    • Open and close the lid firmly. Improper handling of lid may cause leakages.

    For safety and hygiene reasons, replace the Straw Top and Gravity Ball Straw every 2 months.
